title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Customer Service skills in Copilot Cowork
summary: The roadmap facts, licensing statements and all six control surfaces are supported by Microsoft's documentation. The page correctly reports the differing descriptions of plugin activation; the checklist's MCP configuration check has no corresponding control row.

claims.where: Cost and licensing: Limits; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: A low credit limit does not block Cowork access.
claims.quote: A policy with a limit of one credit still grants access. To remove access for a user, remove them from every spending policy that includes Cowork. A low credit limit doesn't block access.

claims.claim: Credit limits are spending safeguards rather than real-time access gates because enforcement is asynchronous.
claims.quote: Credit limits are a spending safeguard, not a real-time access gate. Credit consumption and limit enforcement are evaluated asynchronously
